name: MonarchAiReasoning
title: AiReasoning
wrapsNative: MonarchCollapsible (androidx.compose.animation.AnimatedVisibility) with androidx.compose.foundation.text.selection.SelectionContainer, MonarchAiThinkingIndicator before text arrives, android.icu.text.MeasureFormat for the duration
summary: The model's reasoning for one answer, as a disclosure that reads "Thinking…" with a live timer while it streams and "Thought for 12s" once it finishes.
whenToUse: In an assistant message, for a reasoning part from the message model, so people can see that the model is working and read how it reached the answer if they want to.
whenNotToUse: For a waiting state before any reasoning or answer exists, use MonarchAiThinkingIndicator. For the steps of a tool-using run, use MonarchAiChainOfSteps.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiReasoning(part: MonarchAiReasoningPart, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, startedAt: Long? = null, initiallyExpanded: Boolean = false, onExpandedChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, expandIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiReasoningLabels = MonarchAiReasoningLabels())

class MonarchAiReasoningLabels(prefix: String? = null, thinking: String? = null, thoughtFor: ((String) -> String)? = null, thought: String? = null, reasoningHidden: String? = null, duration: ((Long) -> String)? = null)

options.name: part
options.description: The reasoning part from the message model: its text, whether it streams, its durationMs and whether it is redacted.

options.name: startedAt
options.description: When the reasoning started, in epoch milliseconds. Pass it when the view can leave the composition while the part streams, for example in a lazy list, so the timer does not restart. Counts from when streaming was first seen when null.

options.name: initiallyExpanded
options.description: Whether finished reasoning starts open. Streaming reasoning always starts open.

options.name: onExpandedChange
options.description: Called when the disclosure opens or closes, by the person or automatically when the reasoning finishes or starts again.

options.name: icon
options.description: The assistant mark of the thinking indicator and the still row, tinted with the strong assistant color. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: expandIcon
options.description: An icon after the header, such as a chevron; it turns half a turn while open.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the duration format.

states.name: streaming, no text yet
states.description: A MonarchAiThinkingIndicator with the assistant mark, "Thinking…" and the elapsed time after 3 seconds.

states.name: streaming
states.description: Open; the header reads "Thinking…", then "Thinking… 5s" after 3 seconds, ticking once a second; the text below grows.

states.name: finished
states.description: Closed; the header reads "Thought for" the part's durationMs, or the time this view measured, or "Thought" when neither is known.

states.name: touched
states.description: If the person opens or closes it while it streams, it stays as they left it when the reasoning finishes.

states.name: restarted
states.description: When a finished part streams again (a regeneration), it opens and measures again.

states.name: redacted
states.description: A still row with the mark and "Reasoning hidden"; no disclosure and no text.

appearance: The MonarchCollapsible header in the label style, the reasoning text in the body style in the muted text color, and the mark in the strong assistant color. All are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Same names and states as iOS, with Kotlin names: startedAt is epoch milliseconds, startsExpanded is initiallyExpanded and the duration label takes milliseconds as a Long. The web renders the text with AiStreamingText; Android, like iOS, uses selectable plain text because there is no streaming text component yet. The web chevron leads; MonarchCollapsible puts the icon at the end, and Monarch bundles no icons, so the chevron and the assistant mark are slots. The web prefixes the summary with hidden text; Android names the group "Assistant reasoning" for TalkBack. The web's locale prop is the device locale here. The plan's live timer is in the header text, which TalkBack reads when it reaches it and never announces. The composable is experimental: an AI panel that waits for a Rook app to adopt it.
accessibility: The header is MonarchCollapsible's button with the state Expanded or Collapsed and the TalkBack expand and collapse actions, and a 48dp touch target.
The whole is a traversal group named "Assistant reasoning".
Redacted or empty reasoning is one element read as "Assistant reasoning: Reasoning hidden" with no button.
The live timer is not announced; the thinking indicator's announcement is turned off.
With animations off the disclosure opens and closes at once and the mark stops pulsing; the timer still ticks once a second.
The header wraps at the largest font size.
edgeCases: A part that streams with no text yet shows the thinking indicator, then becomes a disclosure when text arrives.
A durationMs on the part wins over the time this view measured.
Durations round to whole seconds and are at least 1 second.
Long reasoning wraps; the disclosure has no height limit.

examples.title: Finished, collapsed
examples.template:
MonarchAiReasoning(
    part = MonarchAiReasoningPart(
        text = {{text}},
        durationMs = {{durationMs}},
    ),
    expandIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
)
examples.code:
MonarchAiReasoning(
    part = MonarchAiReasoningPart(
        text = "Compare both drafts, then list what changed in the budget section.",
        durationMs = 12_000,
    ),
    expandIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
)

examples.title: Streaming reasoning in a lazy list
examples.code:
MonarchAiReasoning(
    part = MonarchAiReasoningPart(text = "Looking at the monthly rows…", state = MonarchAiPartState.Streaming),
    startedAt = 1_800_000_000_000L,
)
